description: The register data a confirmation statement form is built from -- MadeUpDate, NextDueDate, SIC codes, RegisteredEmailAddress, officers, PSCs, StatementOfCapital, Shareholdings, TradingOnMarket, DTR5Applies, the PSC exemption flags, and whether the payment period is paid -- over the deployed API. The company authentication code is not an argument: the user types it on the link request_companies_house_codes (kind confirmation-statement-data) answers, and this call names that entry by codesEntryId, which it uses up.

codesEntryId.description: The entryId request_companies_house_codes answered, once the user has typed the codes on its link

companyType.description: The company type, when the gateway needs it to resolve the request

madeUpDate.description: The confirmation statement's made-up date, YYYY-MM-DD

name: get_confirmation_statement_data_sandbox
title: Get confirmation statement data
